newsitem.title: USA: CBOE, AMEX to trade Genzyme Transgenics options.
newsitem.headline: CBOE, AMEX to trade Genzyme Transgenics options.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange said Tuesday they would begin trading options on shares of Genzyme Transgenics Corp on March 17.
The options would open with strike prices of 7-1/2, 10 and 12-1/2. At the AMEX, position limits of 4,500 contracts have been set. The stock was up 3/8 at 9-3/8 Tuesday afternoon.

Initial expirations have been set for April, May, June and September. At the CBOE, LETCO has been named designated primary market maker, while AGS Specialist Partners has been named specialist at the AMEX.
